baseline: Package7 installed; candidate builds must retain independent build identities
scope: read-only snapshots and offline measured deltas, not automatic device tests or kernel tuning

analysis.charge_counter_units: microampere-hours per Linux power_supply ABI; device calibration unqualified
analysis.counter_reset_or_wrap: reject affected delta; reject comparison on boot/uptime mismatch

gates.screen_off: User separately authorizes device collection, performs unplug/screen actions manually, records interval conditions; no ADB polling through idle
gates.memory: Record workload and repeated app-switch sequence manually; retain PSI, reclaim, zram and LMKD observations together; no app-retention claims from fixtures
gates.power_hints: Registered service/property is an observation; effective boost delivery and release need separate authorized traces
gates.battery: Repeated controlled comparable intervals on each build; account for USB reconnect and sampling, temperature, radios, apps and fuel-gauge uncertainty
